ideal: Alert: Microsoft and Alphabet both posted quarterly earnings (8-K item 2.02); Microsoft also filed its 10-Q and a separate 8-K (item 8.01). Each comes with a link, and the proxy filing (PX14A6G) is skipped.

verdicts.note: Short and correct on earnings, but it links only the 10-Q for Microsoft (not the earnings 8-K), leaves out the extra 8-K (item 8.01), and the closing line about price moves adds little.
verdicts.answer:
Microsoft (Oct 28): quarterly report (10-Q) and a current-events report (8-K, results of operations) — quarterly earnings. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436133/msft-20260930.htm

Alphabet (Oct 28): current-events report (8-K, results of operations) — quarterly earnings. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000080/goog-20261028.htm

No unusual price move versus the S&P 500 was flagged for either name that day.

Microsoft reported quarterly results (10-Q, with results-of-operations 8-K); Alphabet did too (8-K with results items). No price moves or index comparison data in the report to contextualize.

Microsoft: filed 10-Q quarterly report and 8-K with results-of-operations (items 2.02, 9.01) [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436133/msft-20260930.htm), [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526436122/msft-20261028.htm)

**Microsoft:** filed its quarterly earnings results (8-K, item 2.02) along with its quarterly report (10-Q). It also filed a separate current-events report (8-K, item 8.01) that the report doesn't describe.
